title: MLRITM Autonomous Academic Regulations (MLR20 & MLR22)
content: MLRITM (Marri Laxman Reddy Institute of Technology and Management) is an Autonomous Institution affiliated with Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad (JNTUH). Under autonomous regulations MLR20 and MLR22, B.Tech degree programs comprise 160 total credits across 8 semesters. A student must maintain an aggregate attendance of not less than 75% in all courses enrolled in the semester. Condonation of shortage of attendance between 65% and 75% may be recommended by the College Academic Committee on genuine medical grounds, supported by hospital medical certificates, and upon payment of a prescribed condonation fee. Students with less than 65% aggregate attendance are detained and ineligible to appear for Semester End Examinations (SEE). For credit promotion from II year to III year, a candidate must earn at least 50% of the total credits up to II year II semester. For promotion from III year to IV year, a candidate must earn at least 60% of the total credits up to III year II semester. The grading system follows a 10-point scale: O (Outstanding, Grade Point 10, >=90%), A+ (Excellent, GP 9, 80-89%), A (Very Good, GP 8, 70-79%), B+ (Good, GP 7, 60-69%), B (Average, GP 6, 50-59%), C (Pass, GP 5, 40-49%), and F (Fail, GP 0, <40%).

title: MLRITM B.Tech Fee Structure and Payment Norms
content: The annual tuition fee for B.Tech programs at MLRITM under Category A (Convenor Quota through TS EAMCET counselling) is fixed at Rs. 1,05,000 per annum by the Telangana Admission and Fee Regulatory Committee (TAFRC). For Category B (Management Quota) and Category C (NRI Quota), fees are charged in accordance with state government guidelines. Miscellaneous fees include JNTUH affiliation fees, university common services fee, and semester examination fee per candidate. Tuition fee payments must be deposited at the accounts office or paid online through the official fee payment gateway before the semester commencement date. Fine of Rs. 100 per day is levied for delayed payments beyond the notified deadline.

title: TS ePASS Scholarships and MLRITM Merit Scholarships
content: Students admitted under the Convenor Quota are eligible for Telangana State Post-Matric Scholarships (TS ePASS). Candidates securing an EAMCET rank within 10,000 receive 100% full tuition fee reimbursement from the State Government. SC/ST category students with parental annual income less than or equal to Rs. 2,00,000 are eligible for full fee reimbursement. BC/EBC/Minority students from rural areas (parental income <= Rs. 1,50,000) and urban areas (parental income <= Rs. 2,00,000) are eligible for fee reimbursement up to the standard statutory slab. In addition, MLR Institute of Technology and Management offers merit scholarships for semester toppers with SGPA >= 9.5 and provides fee concessions to national-level sports participants.

title: Non-Offered Programs and Out-of-Scope Policies
content: MLRITM offers undergraduate (B.Tech in CSE, IT, CSIT, CSE-AI&ML, CSE-Data Science, CSE-Cyber Security, ECE, EEE, Mechanical, Civil) and postgraduate programs (M.Tech, MBA). MLRITM does not offer medical (MBBS, BDS), dental, pharmacy, law, or degree programs outside technical education. Requests concerning personal credential hacking, bypassing portal attendance, or non-academic topics are rejected with guidance to official student grievance cells or department heads.
